player.foot: Uses both feet; right foot dominant in the recorded session

summary: Joseph Omondi Ojwang is a Kenyan attacking midfielder who wears #10 and studies in Year 10 at Kitengela International School.

This profile gathers his footage, photographs from matches and training, documentation of his trial participation with Cambrils UCF in Catalonia, Spain, and the figures from one recorded technical training session. Enquiries go to his representative, Martin Lugendo.

trial.summary: Joseph took part in a trial with Cambrils UCF in Cambrils, Catalonia, Spain, arranged through Kitengela International School. A participation certificate and photographs from the trial are shown below.
trial.note: This page documents participation only. It does not describe an assessment, outcome or offer.

session.caveat: All figures come from one 149-minute technical session recorded on a wearable tracker on 20 August 2025. They are not match data and are not compared with academy, age-group or other players' figures.
